visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds an iPhone in a grey case, showing the control center with 'No Service' and 54% battery status against a blurred green park background. (2) A woman with freckles and sunglasses is seen from a medium close-up, holding a red popsicle and talking while standing in a bright outdoor parking lot with cars in the background. (3) A bald man in a blue shirt is filmed in a medium shot against a clear blue sky, speaking emphatically with expressive hand gestures. (4) Inside a car, the woman is in the driver's seat speaking, with two young children visible in the back seats through the rearview and side perspectives. (5) The bald man pushes a green shopping cart filled with supplies across a sunny supermarket parking lot towards the camera. (6) The man is shown outdoors, wearing headphones, meticulously grilling food on a small yellow charcoal BBQ grill while holding a bag of 'CarbriCa' charcoal. (7) The family is seated at a dining table in a dimly lit indoor room, eating dinner as dusk light filters through large glass windows behind them. (8) The man, now in a red hoodie, demonstrates a yellow flashlight in a brightly lit kitchen environment, pointing it at the camera. (9) In a dark room, shadows of hands making shapes are projected onto the white ceiling. (10) The interior lights suddenly flash on, and the family is shown jumping, clapping, and cheering in a spacious, modern living room. (11) A close-up shot of a young boy in a red athletic shirt looking upwards with a worried and disappointed expression.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Complication -> Solution -> Resolution -> Twist
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a family's lighthearted response to a large-scale power and signal outage. It captures the initial confusion, the practical steps taken (buying charcoal and flashlights), the shared family experience of eating in the dark, and the eventual joyful return of power, concluding with a comedic twist about children's reluctance to return to school.
